Description: Workshop 2A. Sealed TradeType root + four concrete trades via Builder. Groups TICKET-ADV018 through ADV022.

Summary: RECONX-E5 — Day 2: Factories, Value Objects & Exceptions
Description: Workshop 2B. Factory, value objects, exception ladder, recon-rule enum. Groups TICKET-ADV023 through ADV026.
Workshop 2C. Comparable/equals/hashCode, JSR-380, PII-safe toString, Javadoc, PR review. Groups TICKET-ADV027 through ADV032.

Summary: TICKET-ADV018 — Sealed interface TradeType and abstract base
Description: GOAL: closed-world polymorphic root for every trade type + internal shared-state base. DONE WHEN: sealed interface TradeType in com.dbtraining.reconx.model names the 4 permitted concrete types. Abstract base holds shared fields (tradeRef, notional, tradeDate), validates non-null on construction. Compiles no warnings; an implementer outside the permits list fails compilation.

GOAL: first concrete trade with fluent Builder enforcing required fields + invariants at build time. DONE WHEN: EquityTrade is final, no public constructor, reachable only via static builder(). Builder validates required fields BEFORE constructor — missing fields give named error, not deep NPE. Dedicated Side enum (BUY/SELL) replaces stringly-typed direction.

Summary: TICKET-ADV020 — FXTrade (two currencies and FX rate)
Description: GOAL: FX trade type with two currency fields, base-currency notional, FX rate — all type-safe. DONE WHEN: currency fields use java.util.Currency, never String. Builder rejects equal ccy1/ccy2, rejects non-positive fxRate or notionalCcy1. Notional currency convention documented in Javadoc (notional is in ccy1).

Summary: TICKET-ADV021 — BondTrade (coupon, maturity, face value, ISIN)
Description: GOAL: bond trade type with fixed-income fields + fail-fast validation on maturity ordering and ISIN shape. DONE WHEN: couponRate, faceValue and all numeric fields are BigDecimal — no double/float anywhere. Builder rejects maturityDate not strictly after tradeDate. ISIN shape checked (length 12) in Builder.

Summary: TICKET-ADV022 — DerivativeTrade (underlying, strike, expiry, option type)
Description: GOAL: derivative trade type with option-type enum + strike/expiry validation, without over-validating historical records. DONE WHEN: OptionType enum (CALL/PUT) nested on DerivativeTrade. strike is positive BigDecimal; expiry strictly after tradeDate. Class does NOT reject expired derivatives (valid historical record) — document this decision.

GOAL: single entry point constructing any concrete TradeType from a discriminator string + param map, absorbing type-erasure cost so callers stay clean. DONE WHEN: TradeFactory is final, private constructor, single static create(String, Map<String,Object>). Each asset-class string routes to its builder via switch expression. Unknown discriminator / missing key / wrong cast surfaces as InvalidTradeException with a useful message — never raw ClassCastException.

Summary: TICKET-ADV024 — Money and TradeRef value objects
Description: GOAL: two immutable value objects — Money (amount + currency) and TradeRef (regex-validated reference). DONE WHEN: both are records, not classes with setters. Money rejects negative amounts + mismatched currencies in add(); currency is java.util.Currency, not String. TradeRef validates its string form against the platform pattern (3 uppercase letters, dash, 8 digits, dash, 4 digits) in its compact constructor.

GOAL: exception ladder rooted at abstract ReconException with 4 concrete subtypes (construction, lookup, duplication, reconciliation). DONE WHEN: ReconException is abstract, extends RuntimeException (unchecked). 4 subtypes: InvalidTradeException, TradeNotFoundException, DuplicateTradeRefException, ReconciliationMismatchException. Each has (String) and (String, Throwable) constructors — chained causes not lost. All in com.dbtraining.reconx.exception.

GOAL: model the closed set of recon tolerance rules as an enum with thresholds + a behaviour method per constant. DONE WHEN: ReconciliationRule enum with >=4 constants (exact, price tolerance, quantity tolerance, loose) carrying BigDecimal thresholds. matches(...) method compares two (price, quantity) pairs against the constant's tolerances. No double anywhere — comparisons use BigDecimal only.

GOAL: give TradeType a natural ordering safe for TreeSet/TreeMap, consistent with the equality added in ADV028. DONE WHEN: TradeType extends Comparable<TradeType>. Ordering is newest-trade-date first, ties broken by TradeRef ascending. A heterogeneous list (equity, FX, bond, derivative) sorts deterministically with no NPE.

Summary: TICKET-ADV028 — equals and hashCode keyed on tradeRef
Description: GOAL: value-based equality on every concrete trade, keyed on natural business key tradeRef, so collections behave correctly pre/post-persist. DONE WHEN: every concrete trade overrides equals and hashCode. Equality keyed on tradeRef alone — not id, not every field. A HashSet of two trades with same tradeRef but different other fields has size 1.

Summary: TICKET-ADV029 — JSR-380 validation on the request DTO
Description: GOAL: declarative validation on the inbound HTTP DTO, leaving the domain Builder as second line of defence. DONE WHEN: TradeRequest is a record in com.dbtraining.reconx.dto with JSR-380 (jakarta.validation.constraints) annotations on every field. Annotations match field types (@NotNull/@Positive on BigDecimal, @NotBlank/@Pattern on String). Malformed request rejected at controller boundary; Builder still catches anything slipping through.

GOAL: override toString on every concrete trade so default logging never leaks counterparty/settlement PII. DONE WHEN: each concrete trade has a hand-written toString (not IDE-generated over every field). String includes tradeRef, instrument id, public commercial fields — excludes counterparty refs, full settlement-currency notional, any LEI-like identifier. BigDecimal fields render via toPlainString(), not default toString.

Summary: TICKET-ADV031 — Javadoc on all public domain classes
Description: GOAL: document the public contract of every domain class + public method so a reader could re-implement from Javadoc alone. DONE WHEN: every public class in com.dbtraining.reconx.model has class-level Javadoc explaining purpose. Every public method has Javadoc with @param, @return, @throws as appropriate. No vacuous Javadoc — the contract sentence must add information.

Summary: TICKET-ADV032 — PR review with two approvals
Description: GOAL: open a PR with the day's work + obtain two reviewer approvals before merge. DONE WHEN: PR description summarises scope (2A/2B/2C) and links this guide. Two teammates approved, each checking the PR-review checklist (sealed leaves final, no public constructors, BigDecimal everywhere, Currency not String, equality keyed on tradeRef, ordering consistent with equality, no PII in toString, JSR-380 on DTO only, full Javadoc, exceptions extend ReconException, factory side-effect-free). Merges cleanly; smoke test passes.
